environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_KEY credential for the Cisco Umbrella MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the CISCO_UMBRELLA_API_SECRET credential for the Cisco Umbrella MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Child org ID to act on from an MSP or Multi-org parent key (the same as --org). Leave blank to act on the key's own organization.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank to use https://api.umbrella.com. Set it only to point at a different host, such as a test server; credentials then go to that host.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank to use https://api.umbrella.com/auth/v2/token. It must be on the API host; a token URL on any other host is refused.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Scope sent with the token request. Leave blank: an Umbrella key already carries the scopes it was created with.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank. Reserved for MCP file uploads: no Cisco Umbrella MCP tool in this release takes a file, so the server never opens a local path and this setting has no effect.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_UMBRELLA_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Umbrella requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank; pick a customer with CISCO_UMBRELLA_ORG_ID instead.
